model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the sensitivity across a sequential range of components, categorized by two different quantization types. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Block Index" and is ordered numerically from left to right, featuring major tick labels at 0, 19, 39, 59, and 79. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and uses a logarithmic scale with a range extending from slightly below $10^{-6}$ to just above $10^{-4}$, featuring major tick marks and corresponding dashed horizontal grid lines at $10^{-6}$, $10^{-5}$, and $10^{-4}$. Each block index is represented by a single vertical bar that is color-coded according to the legend in the upper left: blue bars indicate the "4-Fbit" category, and green bars indicate the "2-Fbit" category. The green 2-Fbit bars predominantly occupy the lower to middle block indices (roughly 0 to 57) and represent lower sensitivity values; the shortest bar in the chart is a green bar located near block index 18, with a value around $3 \times 10^{-7}$. The blue 4-Fbit bars appear sporadically among the upper 40s and 50s before exclusively populating the higher block indices from 58 to 79. These blue bars correspond to higher sensitivity levels, showing an increasing trend toward the right side of the chart and culminating in the tallest overall bar at index 79, which reaches a value slightly above $10^{-4}$. The bars are strictly sorted in ascending numerical order by their block index, and aside from the categorical color coding, no specific bars are visually emphasized with shading, outlines, or annotations.
